review_notes: I read the whole file, which has two short proofs. I also read the E6 minuscule counterpart and found the E7 file, which the module docstring says this argument follows. The Geck, E6 and E7 files repeat the same shape: a case split on the generator index that handles the affine-line and split-torus summands. The `inl` case uses `inferInstance`. The `inr` case uses `DiagonalizableGroup.connectedSpace_primeSpectrum_coordinateRing`. A `rw` of the definitions and an application of `CommHopfAlgCat.geometricallyConnectedCommHopfAlgProperty_commonKernelQuotient` follow. Each copy is about six lines and mostly instantiates existing API. The generator algebras are defined separately for each family. A shared lemma would need a new abstraction over those families, and it would save only routine case analysis. That is below the rubric's bar for nontrivial repeated reasoning. Within this file the two proofs share no repeated machinery. I did not inspect the E7 file's proof body or the definitions of the generator coordinate algebras in detail.
